propositions: A narrow factory protocol and immutable route registry must be defined to describe CLI routes and locate parsers without importing handlers or optional dependencies.

The registry must validate duplicate spellings, illegal aliases, retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capabilities, malformed references, and resource state without resolving command handlers.
Derived policy exports must achieve zero delta against current command sets and arms via shadow-parity comparison.
Route records must support lazy handler/parser-factory references, identity/alias/visibility metadata, and capability tracking for composition without import-time side effects.
The custom ArgumentParser must produce deterministic help output (fixed width, UTF-8 LF, trailing newline) and compatibility-shaped parse errors independent of terminal state.
